blocks.text: After leaving Tierra del Fuego behind, begin your journey across the legendary Drake Passage toward Antarctica. Enjoy the vast landscapes of the Southern Ocean, relax on board, and experience the excitement of sailing one of the world's most iconic expedition routes.

blocks.text: As you sail through the Drake Passage en route to King George Island, in the South Shetland Islands, attend an engaging program of lectures and presentations. In the company of expert guides, watch for wildlife from the lounge or the outside decks. You may spot magnificent seabirds, such as albatrosses and petrels, as well as different species of whales on their way south to Antarctica.
